title: Collapse
summary: A dependency-free collapse pattern inspired by Bootstrap.
overview: An original native implementation of the collapse interaction contract using platform primitives.

component.useWhen: Use collapse when its semantic contract fits the task.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid collapse when a simpler native element communicates the task more clearly.

examples.title: Basic Collapse
examples.description: A complete independently runnable collapse preview.

source.html:
Collapse

Example content for this reusable pattern.
source.javascript: export function createCollapse(root){const open=root.querySelector('[data-open]');const surface=root.querySelector('[data-surface]');if(open instanceof HTMLButtonElement&&surface instanceof HTMLDialogElement){const show=()=>surface.showModal();open.addEventListener('click',show);return{destroy(){open.removeEventListener('click',show);}}}return{destroy(){}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-component="collapse"]').forEach(createCollapse);
